paper_metadata.title: Atomic-scale investigation of precipitation on hydrogen-induced Σ3 twin boundary cracking in superalloys

evidence.quote: Here we systematically investigated the different roles of Σ 3s on HIC in modified A286 and IN718 using uniaxial tensile tests and multiscale microstructural characterization.
Here we systematically investigated the different roles of Σ 3s on HIC in modified A286 and IN718 using uniaxial tensile tests and multiscale microstructural characterization.
MA286 was subjected to solution treatment at 980 ℃ for 1 h followed by water quenching, then cold-rolled at 5 % and annealed at 980 ℃ for 1 h.
Subsequently, MA286 was aged at 730 ℃ for 16 h.
IN718 was subjected to solution treatment at 1020 ℃ for 1 h followed by water quenching, then cold-rolled at 5 % and annealed at 1020 ℃ for 20 min before water quenching.
